observations: Photo 0 shows a red freestanding gas cooker with a 5-burner stovetop and an oven below, set in a modern kitchen with grey cabinets and white subway tiles.
Photo 1 shows the same red gas cooker from a slightly different angle, with a 4-burner stovetop visible, set in a kitchen with blue cabinets and white marble countertops.
The brand name 'MAGLIE 3' is visible on the front panel of the cooker in both photos, near the top right of the oven door.
The cooker has a stainless steel stovetop, red body, black oven door with a glass window, and silver control knobs.

The photos appear to be stock images or staged photos, not real-life photos of a used item, as the kitchen settings differ between the two photos and the lighting and cleanliness are too perfect for a second-hand item.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DANIEL ALABO' on both photos, suggesting the images are reused or not original to the seller.
